  let records = [], offset;
  do {
    const args = { baseId: BASE_ID, table, maxRecords: 100 };
    if (offset) args.offset = offset;
    const res = await archestra.tools.call('airtable__list_records', args);
    records.push(...(res.records || []));
    offset = res.offset;
  } while (offset);
  return records;
}

  if (!col) return rows;
  return [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
    let av = a.fields[col] ?? '', bv = b.fields[col] ?? '';
    if (typeof av === 'number' && typeof bv === 'number') return (av - bv) * dir;
    return String(av).localeCompare(String(bv)) * dir;
  });

        <div class="field-row"><span class="field-label">Order Type</span><span class="field-value">${esc(f['Order Type'])}</span></div>
        <div class="field-row"><span class="field-label">Stage</span><span class="field-value"><span class="badge ${stageBadgeClass(f['Stage'])}">${esc(f['Stage'])}</span></span></div>
        <div class="field-row"><span class="field-label">Tracking #</span><span class="field-value mono">${esc(f['Tracking Number']||'—')}</span></div>
        <div class="field-row full"><span class="field-label">Description</span><span class="field-value">${esc(f['Description']||'—')}</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="detail-section">
      <h3>Payment & Links</h3>
      <div class="field-grid">
        <div class="field-row full"><span class="field-label">Stripe Payment Link</span><span class="field-value">${stripeLink}</span></div>
        <div class="field-row full"><span class="field-label">Session ID</span><span class="field-value mono">${esc(f['Session ID']||'—')}</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="detail-section"><h3>Reference Images</h3>${imagesHtml}</div>
    <div class="detail-section"><h3>Design Preview</h3>${previewHtml}</div>
    <div class="detail-section"><h3>Clock Video</h3><div class="field-value">${clockHtml}</div></div>
  `;

  // Airtable attachment URLs are blocked by the app sandbox CSP, so open them
  // through the host instead of trying to render inline <img> tags.
  document.querySelectorAll('.attachment-link-btn[data-url]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      try {
        await archestra.ui.openLink(btn.dataset.url);
      } catch (err) {
        toast('Could not open the attachment', 'error');
      }
    });
  });

  // Staff-only shipping label link. Never rendered in the customer app.
  const shippingLabelBtn = document.getElementById('shippingLabelBtn');
  if (shippingLabelBtn) {
    shippingLabelBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      try {
        await archestra.ui.openLink(String(f['Shipping Label']));
      } catch (err) {
        toast('Could not open the shipping label', 'error');
      }
    });
  }

  // Shared helper: Stripe price + payment link + Airtable write
  async function generateInvoiceAndAdvance({ rec, id, next, unitPriceDollars, fb }) {
    const fld = rec.fields;
    const totalCents = Math.round(unitPriceDollars * fld['Quantity'] * 100);
    const description = `${fld['Product']} (${fld['Color']}) x${fld['Quantity']}`;
    fb.textContent = 'Creating Stripe price…';
    const priceRes = await archestra.tools.call('stripe__stripe_api_write', {
      stripe_api_operation_id: 'PostPrices',
      parameters: {
        unit_amount: totalCents,
        currency: 'usd',
        product_data: { name: description },
      },
    });
    const priceId = priceRes?.id;
    if (!priceId) throw new Error('Stripe did not return a Price ID.');
    fb.textContent = 'Creating Stripe payment link…';
    const plRes = await archestra.tools.call('stripe__stripe_api_write', {
      stripe_api_operation_id: 'PostPaymentLinks',
      parameters: { line_items: [{ price: priceId, quantity: 1 }] },
    });
    const paymentLinkUrl = plRes?.url;
    const paymentLinkId  = plRes?.id;
    if (!paymentLinkUrl || !paymentLinkId) throw new Error('Stripe did not return a valid payment link.');
    fb.textContent = 'Saving to Airtable…';
    await archestra.tools.call('airtable__batch_update_records', {
      baseId: BASE_ID, table: ORDERS_TABLE,
      records: [{ id, fields: { 'fldpbcZIubi8SV0R8': paymentLinkUrl, 'fldyeTnT1YZ9OYGWF': paymentLinkId, [STAGE_FIELD]: next.label } }],
    });
    rec.fields['Stage'] = next.label;
    rec.fields['Stripe Payment Link'] = paymentLinkUrl;
    rec.fields['Session ID'] = paymentLinkId;
    return { totalCents };
  }

  const proceedBtn = document.getElementById('proceedBtn');
  if (proceedBtn) {
    proceedBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const rec = allOrders.find(r => r.id === id);
      const currentStage = rec?.fields['Stage'];
      const next = nextStage(currentStage);
      if (!next) return;
      const fb = document.getElementById('stageFeedback');

      if (currentStage === 'New' && next.label === 'Invoiced') {
        // ── New → Invoiced: Stripe invoice path ──
        proceedBtn.disabled = true;
        proceedBtn.textContent = 'Working…';
        fb.textContent = 'Looking up inventory price…';
        fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
        const fld = rec.fields;
        const product   = fld['Product'];
        const color     = fld['Color'];
        const orderType = fld['Order Type']; // fldchDImCKyz4fN7l
        try {
          const invRes = await archestra.tools.call('airtable__list_records', { baseId: BASE_ID, table: INV_TABLE, maxRecords: 100 });
          const invMatch = (invRes.records || []).find(r => r.fields['Product Name'] === product && r.fields['Color'] === color);

          if (invMatch) {
            // Happy path: catalog price found
            const unitPrice = invMatch.fields['Price'];
            if (!unitPrice) throw new Error(`Inventory record for "${product}" (${color}) has no Price set.`);
            // Stock availability gate: do NOT generate a Stripe link if the
            // matching inventory row can't cover this order's quantity.
            const availStock = Number(invMatch.fields['Stock Count'] ?? 0);
            const orderQty = Number(fld['Quantity']) || 0;
            if (availStock < orderQty) {
              throw new Error(`Not enough stock — only ${availStock} available, order requests ${orderQty}.`);
            }
            const { totalCents } = await generateInvoiceAndAdvance({ rec, id, next, unitPriceDollars: unitPrice, fb });
            fb.textContent = `✓ Payment link created ($${(totalCents/100).toFixed(2)}) — advanced to "Invoiced"`;
            fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
            toast('Stripe link created → Invoiced', 'success');
            renderOrdersTable();
            openOrderDetail(id);

          } else if (orderType === 'Custom Design') {
            // Custom Design: no catalog match — show manual price override
            proceedBtn.disabled = false;
            proceedBtn.textContent = `→ Proceed to ${next.label}`;
            fb.textContent = '';
            const stageSection = proceedBtn.closest('.detail-section');
            if (!stageSection.querySelector('.custom-price-box')) {
              const qty = fld['Quantity'];
              const box = document.createElement('div');
              box.className = 'custom-price-box';
              box.innerHTML = `
                <div class="cpb-label">⚠️ No inventory match for "${esc(product)}" in "${esc(color)}"</div>
                <div class="cpb-hint">Custom Design order — enter a per-unit price. Total will be charged to the customer.</div>
                <div class="cpb-row">
                  <span class="cpb-prefix">$</span>
                  <input type="number" id="customPriceInput" min="0.01" step="0.01" placeholder="0.00">
                  <span style="font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--color-text-secondary,#888);">per unit × ${esc(String(qty))} = <strong id="cpbTotal">—</strong></span>
                </div>
                <div class="cpb-row">
                  <button class="arch-btn arch-btn--primary" id="generateInvoiceBtn">Generate Invoice</button>
                  <span id="cpbFeedback" style="font-size:0.8rem;margin-left:4px;"></span>
                </div>
              `;
              stageSection.appendChild(box);
              const priceInput = box.querySelector('#customPriceInput');
              const totalSpan  = box.querySelector('#cpbTotal');
              priceInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
                const v = parseFloat(priceInput.value);
                totalSpan.textContent = (!isNaN(v) && v > 0) ? `$${(v * qty).toFixed(2)}` : '—';
              });
              box.querySelector('#generateInvoiceBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
                const unitPrice   = parseFloat(priceInput.value);
                const cpbFeedback = box.querySelector('#cpbFeedback');
                if (isNaN(unitPrice) || unitPrice <= 0) {
                  cpbFeedback.textContent = 'Enter a price greater than $0.';
                  cpbFeedback.style.color = '#dc2626';
                  return;
                }
                const genBtn = box.querySelector('#generateInvoiceBtn');
                genBtn.disabled = true;
                genBtn.textContent = 'Working…';
                proceedBtn.disabled = true;
                cpbFeedback.textContent = '';
                try {
                  const { totalCents } = await generateInvoiceAndAdvance({ rec, id, next, unitPriceDollars: unitPrice, fb });
                  fb.textContent = `✓ Payment link created ($${(totalCents/100).toFixed(2)}) — advanced to "Invoiced"`;
                  fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
                  toast('Stripe link created → Invoiced', 'success');
                  renderOrdersTable();
                  openOrderDetail(id);
                } catch(err) {
                  cpbFeedback.textContent = err?.message || String(err);
                  cpbFeedback.style.color = '#dc2626';
                  toast('Invoice generation failed — see detail panel', 'error');
                  genBtn.disabled = false;
                  genBtn.textContent = 'Generate Invoice';
                  proceedBtn.disabled = false;
                }
              });
            }

          } else {
            // Standard order: hard block
            throw new Error(`No inventory record found for "${product}" in "${color}". Add it to Inventory first.`);
          }
        } catch(e) {
          fb.textContent = `Couldn't generate payment link: ${e?.message || e}`;
          fb.className = 'stage-feedback error';
          toast('Transition blocked — see detail panel', 'error');
          proceedBtn.disabled = false;
          proceedBtn.textContent = `→ Proceed to ${next.label}`;
        }

      } else if (currentStage === 'Design/Video in Progress' && next.label === 'In Production') {
        // Require a Design Preview before production can begin.
        const previews = Array.isArray(rec.fields['Design Preview']) ? rec.fields['Design Preview'] : [];
        if (!previews.length) {
          fb.textContent = 'Design is not ready yet — please create the design first. (Hint: invoke the canva-order-design-pipeline skill to generate it.)';
          fb.className = 'stage-feedback error';
          toast('Production blocked — design preview required', 'error');
          proceedBtn.disabled = false;
          proceedBtn.textContent = '→ Proceed to In Production';
          return;
        }

        proceedBtn.disabled = true;
        proceedBtn.textContent = 'Saving…';
        fb.textContent = '';
        fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
        try {
          await archestra.tools.call('airtable__batch_update_records', {
            baseId: BASE_ID, table: ORDERS_TABLE,
            records: [{ id, fields: { [STAGE_FIELD]: next.label } }],
          });
          rec.fields['Stage'] = next.label;
          fb.textContent = `✓ Advanced to "${next.label}"`;
          fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
          toast(`Stage → ${next.label}`, 'success');
          renderOrdersTable();
          openOrderDetail(id);
        } catch(e) {
          fb.textContent = `Error: ${e?.message || e}`;
          fb.className = 'stage-feedback error';
          toast('Failed to advance stage', 'error');
          proceedBtn.disabled = false;
          proceedBtn.textContent = `→ Proceed to ${next.label}`;
        }
      } else if (currentStage === 'Shipped' && next.label === 'Delivered') {
        // Delivery notification: advance Stage first, then send exactly one
        // transactional email to the order's customer.
        proceedBtn.disabled = true;
        proceedBtn.textContent = 'Marking delivered…';
        fb.textContent = '';
        fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
        try {
          await archestra.tools.call('airtable__batch_update_records', {
            baseId: BASE_ID,
            table: ORDERS_TABLE,
            records: [{ id, fields: { [STAGE_FIELD]: next.label } }],
          });
          rec.fields['Stage'] = next.label;

          const recipient = String(rec.fields['Customer Email'] || '').trim();
          if (!recipient) throw new Error('Order has no customer email address.');
          fb.textContent = 'Sending delivery confirmation…';
          await archestra.tools.call('resend_mcp_server__send-email', {
            from: 'onboarding@resend.dev',
            to: [recipient],
            subject: 'Your order has been delivered',
            text: `Hi ${rec.fields['Customer Name'] || 'there'},\n\nYour ${rec.fields['Product'] || 'order'} has been delivered. We hope you enjoy it!\n\nThank you for your order.`,
            idempotencyKey: `delivery-${id}`,
          });

          fb.textContent = '✓ Advanced to Delivered and sent the delivery confirmation.';
          fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
          toast('Delivered — customer notified', 'success');
          renderOrdersTable();
          openOrderDetail(id);
        } catch (err) {
          // Airtable may already be Delivered if only the email failed. Reflect
          // that local truth and show a precise notification error.
          renderOrdersTable();
          fb.textContent = `Delivery update error: ${err?.message || err}`;
          fb.className = 'stage-feedback error';
          toast('Delivery notification failed', 'error');
          proceedBtn.disabled = false;
          proceedBtn.textContent = '→ Proceed to Delivered';
        }
      } else if (currentStage === 'In Production' && next.label === 'Shipped') {
        // If a real label URL already exists on the order, skip ShipStation and
        // advance directly to Shipped.
        proceedBtn.disabled = true;
        proceedBtn.textContent = 'Checking label…';
        fb.textContent = 'Checking for an existing shipping label…';
        fb.className = 'stage-feedback';

        try {
          const existingLabelUrl = String(rec.fields['Shipping Label'] || '').trim();
          if (existingLabelUrl) {
            await archestra.tools.call('airtable__batch_update_records', {
              baseId: BASE_ID,
              table: ORDERS_TABLE,
              records: [{ id, fields: { [STAGE_FIELD]: next.label } }],
            });
            rec.fields['Stage'] = next.label;
            fb.textContent = '✓ Existing shipping label found — advanced to Shipped.';
            fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
            toast('Advanced to Shipped using existing label', 'success');
            renderOrdersTable();
            openOrderDetail(id);
            return;
          }

          // No label on the order yet: run the full ShipStation flow.
          proceedBtn.textContent = 'Creating label…';
          fb.textContent = 'Connecting to ShipStation…';
          const firstArray = (value, preferredKeys = []) => {
            if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
            for (const key of preferredKeys) if (Array.isArray(value?.[key])) return value[key];
            if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
              for (const candidate of Object.values(value)) if (Array.isArray(candidate)) return candidate;
            }
            return [];
          };
          const findString = (value, keys) => {
            if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return '';
            for (const key of keys) if (typeof value[key] === 'string' && value[key]) return value[key];
            for (const child of Object.values(value)) {
              if (child && typeof child === 'object') {
                const found = findString(child, keys);
                if (found) return found;
              }
            }
            return '';
          };
          const parseUsAddress = raw => {
            const parts = String(raw || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
            const stateZip = parts[parts.length - 1]?.match(/^([A-Za-z]{2})\s+(\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?)$/);
            if (parts.length < 3 || !stateZip) throw new Error('Shipping address must be formatted as Street, City, ST ZIP.');
            return {
              address_line1: parts.slice(0, -2).join(', '),
              city_locality: parts[parts.length - 2],
              state_province: stateZip[1].toUpperCase(),
              postal_code: stateZip[2],
              country_code: 'US',
              name: rec.fields['Customer Name'] || 'Customer',
              phone: String(rec.fields['Customer Phone'] || '').trim(),
            };
          };

          const customerPhone = String(rec.fields['Customer Phone'] || '').trim();
          if (!customerPhone) {
            throw new Error('Missing customer phone number — required for shipping label creation. Add one to this order\'s Customer Phone field first.');
          }

          const warehousesRes = await archestra.tools.call('shipstation-api-mcp__get_warehouses', { page: 1, page_size: 50 });
          const warehouses = firstArray(warehousesRes, ['warehouses']);
          const warehouseExists = warehouses.some(w => findString(w, ['warehouse_id', 'id']) === SHIPSTATION_WAREHOUSE_ID);
          if (!warehouseExists) throw new Error(`Configured ShipStation warehouse ${SHIPSTATION_WAREHOUSE_ID} is missing or unavailable.`);

          const carriersRes = await archestra.tools.call('shipstation-api-mcp__get_carriers', { page: 1, page_size: 50 });
          const carriers = firstArray(carriersRes, ['carriers']);
          const carrierId = findString(carriers[0], ['carrier_id', 'id']);
          if (!carrierId) throw new Error('No ShipStation carrier is available.');

          const servicesRes = await archestra.tools.call('shipstation-api-mcp__get_carrier_services', { carrier_id: carrierId });
          const services = firstArray(servicesRes, ['services']);
          const serviceCode = findString(services[0], ['service_code', 'code']);
          if (!serviceCode) throw new Error('No ShipStation service is available for the carrier.');

          fb.textContent = 'Creating ShipStation shipment…';
          const shipmentRes = await archestra.tools.call('shipstation-api-mcp__create_shipment', {
            shipment: {
              warehouse_id: SHIPSTATION_WAREHOUSE_ID,
              carrier_id: carrierId,
              service_code: serviceCode,
              external_shipment_id: id,
              ship_date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
              ship_to: parseUsAddress(rec.fields['Shipping Address']),
              packages: [{
                weight: { value: 1, unit: 'pound' },
                dimensions: { length: 10, width: 8, height: 4, unit: 'inch' },
              }],
              items: [{
                name: rec.fields['Product'] || 'Printed product',
                quantity: Number(rec.fields['Quantity']) || 1,
              }],
            },
          });
          const shipmentId = findString(shipmentRes, ['shipment_id', 'id']);
          if (!shipmentId) throw new Error('ShipStation did not return a shipment ID.');

          fb.textContent = 'Purchasing ShipStation label…';
          const labelRes = await archestra.tools.call('shipstation-api-mcp__create_label_from_shipment', {
            shipment_id: shipmentId,
            label_format: 'pdf',
          });
          const labelUrl = findString(labelRes, ['label_url', 'download_url', 'href', 'url', 'pdf']);
          if (!labelUrl) throw new Error('ShipStation did not return a label URL.');

          fb.textContent = 'Saving label to Airtable…';
          await archestra.tools.call('airtable__batch_update_records', {
            baseId: BASE_ID,
            table: ORDERS_TABLE,
            records: [{ id, fields: { fldaBcYT6Vp5ww89i: labelUrl } }],
          });

          fb.textContent = 'Verifying label on the order…';
          const refreshed = await archestra.tools.call('airtable__get_record', {
            baseId: BASE_ID,
            table: ORDERS_TABLE,
            recordId: id,
          });
          const confirmedLabelUrl = String(refreshed?.fields?.['Shipping Label'] || '').trim();
          if (!confirmedLabelUrl) {
            throw new Error('Shipping Label field did not persist a real label URL.');
          }

          fb.textContent = 'Advancing to Shipped…';
          await archestra.tools.call('airtable__batch_update_records', {
            baseId: BASE_ID,
            table: ORDERS_TABLE,
            records: [{ id, fields: { [STAGE_FIELD]: next.label } }],
          });
          rec.fields['Shipping Label'] = confirmedLabelUrl;
          rec.fields['Stage'] = next.label;
          fb.textContent = '✓ Shipping label created and verified — advanced to Shipped.';
          fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
          toast('Shipment created and label saved → Shipped', 'success');
          renderOrdersTable();
          openOrderDetail(id);
        } catch (err) {
          const msg = err?.message || String(err);
          fb.textContent = `Could not create shipping label: ${msg}. Order was not advanced to Shipped.`;
          fb.className = 'stage-feedback error';
          proceedBtn.disabled = false;
          proceedBtn.textContent = '→ Proceed to Shipped';
          toast('Shipment blocked — label required', 'error');
        }
      } else if (currentStage === 'Invoiced' && next.label === 'Paid') {
        // Invoiced → Paid: payment confirmation (existing check) then a final
        // stock re-check + one-time decrement, then advance the stage.
        proceedBtn.disabled = true;
        proceedBtn.textContent = 'Confirming payment…';
        fb.textContent = '';
        fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
        try {
          // Re-check stock at the moment of payment confirmation, in case
          // another order consumed inventory since this one was invoiced.
          fb.textContent = 'Re-checking stock availability…';
          const invRes = await archestra.tools.call('airtable__list_records', { baseId: BASE_ID, table: INV_TABLE, maxRecords: 100 });
          const invMatch = (invRes.records || []).find(r => r.fields['Product Name'] === rec.fields['Product'] && r.fields['Color'] === rec.fields['Color']);
          if (!invMatch) {
            throw new Error(`No inventory record found for "${rec.fields['Product']}" in "${rec.fields['Color']}".`);
          }
          const availStock = Number(invMatch.fields['Stock Count'] ?? 0);
          const orderQty = Number(rec.fields['Quantity']) || 0;
          if (availStock < orderQty) {
            throw new Error(`Not enough stock — only ${availStock} available, order requests ${orderQty}.`);
          }
          // Decrement stock exactly once, here at Paid.
          fb.textContent = 'Decrementing stock…';
          const newStock = availStock - orderQty;
          await archestra.tools.call('airtable__batch_update_records', {
            baseId: BASE_ID, table: INV_TABLE,
            records: [{ id: invMatch.id, fields: { 'fldrEaR9XzpvTkTWy': newStock } }],
          });
          // Keep any locally cached inventory in sync.
          const cachedInv = allInventory.find(r => r.id === invMatch.id);
          if (cachedInv) cachedInv.fields['Stock Count'] = newStock;
          // Advance the stage.
          fb.textContent = 'Advancing to Paid…';
          await archestra.tools.call('airtable__batch_update_records', {
            baseId: BASE_ID, table: ORDERS_TABLE,
            records: [{ id, fields: { [STAGE_FIELD]: next.label } }],
          });
          rec.fields['Stage'] = next.label;
          fb.textContent = `✓ Payment confirmed, stock decremented by ${orderQty} — advanced to "Paid"`;
          fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
          toast('Paid — stock decremented', 'success');
          renderOrdersTable();
          renderInventoryTable();
          openOrderDetail(id);
        } catch(e) {
          fb.textContent = `Couldn't advance to Paid: ${e?.message || e}`;
          fb.className = 'stage-feedback error';
          toast('Transition blocked — see detail panel', 'error');
          proceedBtn.disabled = false;
          proceedBtn.textContent = `→ Proceed to ${next.label}`;
        }
      } else {
        // ── All other transitions: simple stage write ──
        proceedBtn.disabled = true;
        proceedBtn.textContent = 'Saving…';
        fb.textContent = '';
        fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
        try {
          await archestra.tools.call('airtable__batch_update_records', {
            baseId: BASE_ID, table: ORDERS_TABLE,
            records: [{ id, fields: { [STAGE_FIELD]: next.label } }],
          });
          rec.fields['Stage'] = next.label;
          fb.textContent = `✓ Advanced to "${next.label}"`;
          fb.className = 'stage-feedback';
          toast(`Stage → ${next.label}`, 'success');
          renderOrdersTable();
          openOrderDetail(id);
        } catch(e) {
          fb.textContent = `Error: ${e?.message || e}`;
          fb.className = 'stage-feedback error';
          toast('Failed to advance stage', 'error');
          proceedBtn.disabled = false;
          proceedBtn.textContent = `→ Proceed to ${next.label}`;
        }
      }
    });
  }
}

const INV_COLS = [
  { key: 'Product Name', label: 'Product Name' },
  { key: 'Color',        label: 'Color'        },
  { key: 'Product Type', label: 'Type'         },
  { key: 'Stock Count',  label: 'Stock Count'  },
  { key: 'Price',        label: 'Price'        },
  { key: 'Image',        label: 'Image'        },
];

function getFilteredInventory() {
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInventory').value.toLowerCase();
  return allInventory.filter(r => {
    if (!search) return true;
    const f = r.fields;
    return `${f['Product Name']} ${f['Color']} ${f['Product Type']}`.toLowerCase().includes(search);
  });
}

function renderInventoryTable() {
  let rows = getFilteredInventory();
  rows = sortRowsDir(rows, invSort.col, invSort.dir);
  document.getElementById('invCount').textContent = `${rows.length} product${rows.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
  if (!rows.length) { document.getElementById('inventoryTableWrap').innerHTML = '<div class="state-msg">No products match the search.</div>'; return; }
  const thead = INV_COLS.map(c => {
    const isSorted = invSort.col === c.key;
    const icon = isSorted ? (invSort.dir === 1 ? '▲' : '▼') : '⇅';
    return `<th class="${isSorted?'sorted':''}" data-col="${esc(c.key)}">${esc(c.label)} <span class="sort-icon">${icon}</span></th>`;
  }).join('');
  const tbody = rows.map(r => {
    const f = r.fields;
    const stock = f['Stock Count'] ?? 0;
    let rowClass = '', stockClass = '';
    if (stock < critThresh) { rowClass = 'stock-critical'; stockClass = 'critical'; }
    else if (stock < warnThresh) { rowClass = 'stock-warning'; stockClass = 'warning'; }
    const imgs = f['Image'] || [];
    const imgHtml = imgs.length

      : `<div class="no-img"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5"/><path d="M21 15l-5-5L5 21"/></svg></div>`;
    return `<tr class="${rowClass}" data-inv-id="${esc(r.id)}">
      <td>${esc(f['Product Name'])}</td><td>${esc(f['Color'])}</td><td>${esc(f['Product Type'])}</td>
      <td>
        <div class="stock-edit-wrap">
          <input class="stock-edit-input" type="number" value="${stock}" min="0" data-orig="${stock}">
          <button class="arch-btn arch-btn--ghost stock-save-btn" data-rec-id="${esc(r.id)}">Save</button>
          <span class="stock-saving" id="saving-${esc(r.id)}"></span>
        </div>
        ${stockClass==='critical'?'<div style="font-size:0.7rem;color:#dc2626;margin-top:2px;">🔴 Low stock</div>':stockClass==='warning'?'<div style="font-size:0.7rem;color:#d97706;margin-top:2px;">🟡 Stock low</div>':''}
      </td>
      <td>$${esc(f['Price'])}</td><td>${imgHtml}</td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join('');

  document.querySelectorAll('.stock-edit-input').forEach(input => {
    const saveBtn = input.closest('.stock-edit-wrap').querySelector('.stock-save-btn');
    input.addEventListener('input', () => {
      const dirty = input.value !== input.dataset.orig;
      input.classList.toggle('dirty', dirty);
      saveBtn.classList.toggle('visible', dirty);
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#inventoryTableWrap th').forEach(th => {
    th.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const col = th.dataset.col;
      if (col === 'Image') return;
      if (invSort.col === col) invSort.dir *= -1; else { invSort.col = col; invSort.dir = 1; }
      renderInventoryTable();
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.stock-save-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const recId = btn.dataset.recId;
      const input = btn.closest('.stock-edit-wrap').querySelector('.stock-edit-input');
      const savingEl = document.getElementById(`saving-${recId}`);
      const newVal = parseInt(input.value, 10);
      if (isNaN(newVal) || newVal < 0) { toast('Invalid stock count', 'error'); return; }
      btn.disabled = true;
      savingEl.textContent = 'Saving…';
      try {
        await archestra.tools.call('airtable__batch_update_records', { baseId: BASE_ID, table: INV_TABLE, records: [{ id: recId, fields: { 'Stock Count': newVal } }] });
        const rec = allInventory.find(r => r.id === recId);
        if (rec) rec.fields['Stock Count'] = newVal;
        input.dataset.orig = newVal;
        btn.classList.remove('visible'); btn.classList.add('saved'); input.classList.remove('dirty');
        setTimeout(() => { btn.classList.remove('saved'); }, 1800);
        savingEl.textContent = '✓ Saved';
        setTimeout(() => { savingEl.textContent = ''; }, 2000);
        toast('Stock updated', 'success');
        renderInventoryTable();
      } catch(e) { savingEl.textContent = ''; toast(`Failed: ${e.message}`, 'error'); }
      finally { btn.disabled = false; }
    });
  });

});

await Promise.all([loadOrders(), loadInventory()]);
</script>
